How to Play

Knock your opponents off the stage. The higher their %, the further they fly.

Finisher
V
Smash (big hit)
Smash: press V once
  1. A ring fills around you while it's charging, about half a second. You can still move and jump.
  2. It goes off by itself, turned toward the nearest foe. Holding ← or → points it that way instead.
  3. Want to wait for the right moment? Keep V held: the smash stays charged until you let go.
  4. If it touches them, they take all of its damage and its effect. (Freezing only works once they're hurt.)
  5. Angle it: once it's charged, hold ↑ or ↓ and it waits for you. Let go to fire it, angled up or flatter. ↑ also jumps, so you can jump, wait, and fire on the way down.
Every fighter's smash moves differently
Lungeyou move forward; the first foe you touch is hit
Dashyou rush forward; anyone you run into is hit
Hopyou jump at the nearest foe and stomp down
Pullnearby foes are dragged in, then hit
Shockwavea shockwave bursts out around you
Root & blastyou stand still, then everyone near you is hit
Rollersomething rolls away along the ground
Beaman instant straight line
Dropsomething falls on the nearest foe after a warning
Trapyou leave something the first foe to step on sets off
Its owna few are unique: a counter stance, a cloud, a curse, a dive, a gadget, coins
The character screen shows which one yours is, how far it reaches and what it does.
Every fighter's C special is different — that's the fun part.
